details:
VRC needs more options for buying and selling.

1. If you could include multiple high quality body models (SFW) that either is compatible with all cosmetics sold. Or specific visible body models. That would be a cool feature.

Some simple models could be free, while more advanced models paid.

2. Selling of full finished avatars with some different variations to pick from that bought avatar. Or different choices to buy from that specific avatar. 

Even having cheaper alternatives for those avis by offerring very limited features as a simple base for simple or cheap people.

3. Selling cosmetics that can be clothes, ears, tails, piercings, body tattos, body color, pets and more. Would also be nice with some free options too.

4. Avatar Customization slot in home menu UI. 

A: Different squares of standard cosmetics for example: body, hat, sweater, shirt, pants, shoes. etc. 

B: Control what cosmetics to put into action bars, and pick standard cosmetics. 

This could also be used to control avatars that are not neccesarily paid through the game.

Would make it easier to control your features and also mix them up youreself.

Also to remove uneccesary action bars that you dont feel you need.

5. Actual shopping inside worlds:

Make it possible for worlds to feature free and paid options similar to avatar hunting. It would make world shopping an actual feature. It would be great for seeing items in full and real display. Example items/things on table or floor or on shelf in true size.

6. Selling Finished Worlds

Selling finished and high quality worlds.

Potentially offers you some options to change them.

If such a system would be implemented, it would likely need for a personal customize location such as in 4th feature.

And Also work for different platforms yet mostly the platforms that can access the shop.

This feature does sound complicated. Yet it is better to start from somewhere. 

And i love ideas even if not possible, it can make ideas for similar features.

I Always wished for such a system to be introduced to VRC.

To avoid having to go through the trouble of using unity and using 3rd party sites for avatar and cosmetic hunting. And also making life in VRC as simple as possible. And also it would make shopping an actual VR thing.
title: Selling models, avatars, cosmetics, etc + customization UI
